name: Twin-engined bomber (our own model)
about: Made by Tools/build_plane.py. Metres; x forward, y right, z up, the middle of the fuselage at the origin. Paints: 0 upper, 1 upper2, 2 under, 3 nose, 4 boss, 5 glass, 6 frame, 7 steel, 8 tyre, 9 blade, 10 line, 11 soot, 12 engine, 13 leg, 14 bomb, 15 stain, 16 glare, 17 glint Its bomb bay (Tools/bay_doors.py): `part` says which part each point belongs to, `parts` are the parts (0 the machine, 1 and 2 the bay doors, turned about their axis through their pivot, plus opens, 3 the bombs in the bay). Paints 18 bay roof, 19 bay walls.
